title: Parking lot repaving
script:
Man: Hi, Carla, the parking lot will be repaved next Tuesday, so cars can't be parked there.
Woman: Next Tuesday? I usually park there every morning.
Man: Right. You can use the garage across the street that day. The company will cover the fee.
Woman: Thanks. Will they let us know when the lot reopens?
Man: Yes, a notice will go up on the board by the elevator on Monday.
Woman: Good. I'll tell my team to check the notice.
translation:
男性:やあ、カーラ。来週の火曜に駐車場の舗装工事があるから、そこには車を止められないよ。
女性:来週の火曜?私は毎朝そこに停めているのよ。
男性:そうだね。その日は道の向かいの駐車場ビルを使ってくれていいよ。会社が料金を負担するから。
女性:ありがとう。再開したら教えてもらえる?
男性:うん、月曜にエレベーター横の掲示板に知らせを出すよ。
女性:わかったわ。チームにも掲示を確認するよう伝えておくね。

questions.question: What is going to happen to the parking lot next Tuesday?
choices: It will get a new surface.
It will be painted for the company party.
It will be sold to a new owner.
It will be used for a food market.
questions.explanation: 来週の火曜に駐車場の舗装工事があると男性は言っている。

questions.question: Where can the woman park that day?
choices: In the visitor lot near the entrance.
In the parking structure opposite.
On the street behind the office.
In the basement of the building.
questions.explanation: その日は道の向かいの駐車場ビルを使えると言われている。料金は会社が負担する。

questions.question: What will happen on Monday?
choices: The company will hire a contractor.
The manager will call each employee.
A notice will be posted near the elevator.
The garage will close for repairs.
questions.explanation: 月曜にエレベーター横の掲示板に、再開の知らせを出すと言っている。

title: Recruitment fair booth location
graphic:
University recruitment fair: schedule
-----------------------------------
 Hall         Booths     Opens
 Main hall    1-40       9:00 a.m.
 Annex        41-60      10:00 a.m.
 Gym          61-80      9:30 a.m.
script:
Woman: Tom, did you confirm our booth at the university recruitment fair?
Man: Yes, but the organizers moved us from the main hall to the annex building. We're booth fifty-two.
Woman: The annex is much quieter. Students might not walk over there.
Man: They said the annex will have a shuttle from the main gate every twenty minutes, so visitors can get there easily.
Woman: That helps. Did you ask whether we can have a larger table?
Man: They said the table size is fixed, but we can bring a standing banner.
translation:
女性:トム、大学の就職フェアの出展ブースは確認した?
男性:うん、でも主催者からメインホールから別館に移されたんだ。ブースは52番だよ。
女性:別館はずっと静かね。学生がそっちまで歩いてくれないかもしれないわ。
男性:別館にはメインゲートから20分おきにシャトルが出るそうだから、来場者は行きやすいはずだよ。
女性:それなら安心ね。テーブルを大きくできるか聞いた?
男性:テーブルの大きさは決まっているけど、立ち看板は持ち込んでいいそうだ。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. What time does our booth open?
choices: At nine in the morning
At nine thirty in the morning
At ten in the morning
At noon
questions.explanation: ブース52番は図表の別館(41〜60番)にあり、開場は午前10時である。

questions.question: Where is the booth located now?
choices: In the gym on the second floor.
In the main hall next to the entrance.
In a separate building, away from the main hall.
In an outdoor tent area.
questions.explanation: 主催者によって、メインホールから別館に移された。

questions.question: What does the man say about the shuttle?
choices: Visitors must book a seat in advance.
A taxi waits at the annex entrance.
Buses leave the main gate at regular intervals.
Parking at the annex is free.
questions.explanation: 別館にはメインゲートから20分おきにシャトルが出ると男性は言っている。

title: Late delivery refund request
script:
Man: Mrs. Okada says her order arrived four days late, and she wants a full refund.
Woman: Our policy only offers a partial refund for delays under a week, so that's not possible.
Man: She's a loyal customer, though. She's bought from us every month for three years.
Woman: I understand. But the courier was late, not us, so the refund rule doesn't cover it.
Man: Could we offer her a discount on her next order instead?
Woman: We could, but I'd rather check with the courier first. If they accept responsibility, we can refund her in full.
Man: Good. Let me call the courier now and get their report.
translation:
男性:オカダさんから、注文品が4日遅れて届いたので全額返金してほしいと連絡が来ています。
女性:当社の方針では、1週間未満の遅れは一部返金だけなの。全額は無理よ。
男性:でも、オカダさんは3年間毎月注文してくださっている大事なお客さんですよ。
女性:それはわかるわ。でも遅れの原因は配送会社で、当社ではないから、返金の規則の対象にはならないのよ。
男性:それなら、次回の注文を値引きするのはどうでしょう?
女性:できるけど、先に配送会社に確認したいわ。向こうが責任を認めれば、全額返金できるから。
男性:わかりました。今すぐ配送会社に電話して、報告書をもらいますね。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'd rather check with the courier first."?
choices: She plans to cancel the courier contract.
She wants to confirm who is responsible before deciding on the refund.
She thinks Mrs. Okada is lying about the delay.
She has already decided to reject the claim.
questions.explanation: 返金を決める前に、配送会社が責任を認めるかを確かめたいという意味である。

questions.question: What does the woman say about the delay?
choices: It was caused by the courier, not the store.
It happened because of a damaged package.
It was the customer's fault for choosing the wrong address.
It was approved by the store manager in advance.
questions.explanation: 遅れの原因は配送会社で、店ではないので返金の規則の対象外だと女性は言っている。

questions.question: What will the man most likely do next?
choices: Offer Mrs. Okada a discount on her next order.
Refund the full amount right away.
Send a new shipment to Mrs. Okada.
Phone the courier for their report.
questions.explanation: 男性は今すぐ配送会社に電話して報告書をもらうと言っている。

title: Museum poster loan agreement
script:
Man: The museum wants to borrow our 1960s poster collection for a show next spring.
Woman: That would be great for publicity. But the last loan came back with a torn poster, and we're still waiting for the insurance payment.
Man: The museum says it has new custom crates, so the risk should be much lower this time.
Woman: Crates help, but the damage last time happened during the handling in their own building, not on the road.
Man: So you're saying they should prove their handling procedures first.
Woman: Exactly. I'd agree if they sign an agreement that puts the insurance responsibility on them.
Man: They've already said they'd accept that, so the problem may be solved.
Woman: Then let's read the draft carefully before we sign anything.
translation:
男性:博物館が来春の展示に、うちの1960年代のポスターコレクションを借りたいそうだよ。
女性:宣伝にはいい話ね。でも前回の貸し出しでは、ポスターが破れて戻ってきたし、保険金はまだ支払われていないのよ。
男性:博物館は新しい専用の箱を用意したそうだから、今回は危険がずっと少ないはずだよ。
女性:箱は役に立つけど、前回の破損は道中ではなく、博物館の中での扱いの最中に起きたのよ。
男性:つまり、まず扱いの手順を示してもらうべきだということだね。
女性:そのとおり。保険の責任を向こうに負わせる合意書にサインしてくれるなら賛成できるわ。
男性:向こうはもうそれを受け入れると言っているから、問題は解決するかもしれないね。
女性:じゃあ、サインする前に草案をよく読みましょう。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "Crates help, but the damage last time happened during the handling in their own building."?
choices: The museum has already repaired the torn poster.
Better equipment alone does not prevent damage if handling is careless.
The crates are too large for the gallery.
The insurance has already paid the full claim.
questions.explanation: 専用の箱があっても、扱いが雑なら破損は防げないという意味である。前回の破損は博物館内の扱いで起きている。

questions.question: Why is the woman hesitant about the loan?
choices: The posters are too valuable to insure.
The spring show has already been canceled.
The museum wants a discount on the loan fee.
The museum has not shown that it can handle the works safely.
questions.explanation: 博物館が安全に扱えることをまだ示していないので、女性は貸し出しに慎重である。

questions.question: What will the speakers most likely do next?
choices: Check the draft agreement for insurance terms.
Send the posters to the museum immediately.
Ask the museum for a higher loan fee.
Cancel the spring show.
questions.explanation: サインする前に、保険の責任を定めた草案を読むと女性は言っている。

title: Gala seating plan revisions
script:
Woman: The gala seating plan is almost done, but the sponsors have sent new requests.
Man: Their first request was to sit near the stage. We put them at table one, but the director rejected that.
Woman 2: Why? Table one is the best spot for visibility.
Man: The director says the stage view is blocked by the sound equipment, so tables near the front are no good.
Woman: So we move the sponsors to table four, which is on the left side and has a clear view.
Woman 2: Table four can't seat them. The sponsor's company wants ten seats, and table four only fits eight.
Man: Then we combine table four with the one next to it. That gives us the room, and staff can move the centerpiece.
Woman: That works on paper. But the caterer says the combined table can't use the side entrance, so guests would walk farther.
Woman 2: Then let's leave the sponsors at table seven, at the back, and offer them a reserved sign and a premium drink ticket instead.
translation:
女性:ガラの座席表がほぼできたけど、スポンサーから新しい要望が来たの。
男性:最初の要望はステージ近くだった。1番テーブルにしたけど、部長が却下したんだ。
女性2:どうして?1番テーブルは一番よく見える場所でしょう。
男性:部長によると、ステージが音響機材で見えにくくなるから、前方のテーブルはだめだそうだ。
女性:じゃあ、左側で見通しのいい4番テーブルに移しましょう。
女性2:4番テーブルでは座れないわ。スポンサーの会社は10席必要なのに、4番は8席しかないの。
男性:それなら4番と隣のテーブルをくっつけよう。席は足りるし、スタッフが中央の飾りを移動できる。
女性:机上では問題ないわね。でもケータリングの人によると、くっつけたテーブルは横の入口を使えなくて、客が遠回りになるそうよ。
女性2:それなら、スポンサーは会場の一番奥の7番テーブルにして、予約席の札と特別なドリンク券を付けましょう。

questions.question: Where will the sponsors most likely be seated?
choices: At table one, near the stage.
At a table toward the rear, with extra perks.
At table four, combined with a neighboring table.
At a combined table next to the side entrance.
questions.explanation: 1番と4番は外れ、くっつけた案も入口が使えず却下された。最終的に奥の7番テーブルに、特典を付けて座ってもらう案になっている。

questions.question: Why was table four ruled out?
choices: It cannot seat the sponsor's full group.
It is too close to the stage.
Its view is blocked by equipment.
It is next to the side entrance.
questions.explanation: スポンサーの会社は10席必要だが、4番テーブルは8席しかない。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "That works on paper."?
choices: She has already approved the new seating plan.
The plan looks good, but it has a practical drawback.
She thinks the sponsors will like the combined table.
She wants the caterer to change the menu.
questions.explanation: くっつけたテーブルは計画上は成り立つが、入口が使えず客が遠回りになるという実際の問題があるという意味である。

title: Cafeteria hours during holiday week
script:
Woman: Hi, Ken. Is the cafeteria open during the holiday week?
Man: Only until eleven in the morning. It closes early for the cleaning.
Woman: That's a shame. I usually eat lunch at noon.
Man: You can get sandwiches from the vending machine on the second floor.
Woman: Good idea. Do they take cards?
Man: Only coins and cards. Cash isn't accepted.
translation:
女性:こんにちは、ケン。連休の週は社員食堂は開いている?
男性:午前11時までだけだよ。掃除のために早めに閉まるんだ。
女性:残念ね。いつもお昼は12時に食べているのよ。
男性:2階の自動販売機でサンドイッチが買えるよ。
女性:いい考えね。カードは使える?
男性:硬貨とカードだけだよ。現金は使えないんだ。

questions.question: What time does the cafeteria close?
choices: At 11 a.m.
At 2 p.m.
At 5 p.m.
At noon.
questions.explanation: 食堂は午前11時までと言われている。掃除のため早めに閉まる。

questions.question: Why is the woman disappointed?
choices: The vending machine is out of order.
She cannot pay with cash.
Her usual lunchtime routine would be disrupted.
The cafeteria is always closed on Fridays.
questions.explanation: 女性はいつも12時に昼食をとるので、食堂が早く閉まるのは困ると言っている。

questions.question: How can the woman pay at the vending machine?
choices: With a check.
With a mobile app only.
Free of charge.
Using change or a debit card.
questions.explanation: 自動販売機は硬貨とカードだけが使える。現金は使えない。

title: Office furniture delivery delays
graphic:
Office furniture delivery: time windows
------------------------------------
 Item      Window           Status
 Chairs    Morning 8-12     Delayed
 Desks     Afternoon 1-5    On schedule
 Lamps     Afternoon 1-5    Cancelled
script:
Man: Hi, Rina, the office furniture delivery is running late again. Which part is still missing?
Woman: The chairs were supposed to come this morning, but the truck is stuck on the highway.
Man: They said the chairs will arrive after lunch, so they're still on track for today.
Woman: What about the desks? They were supposed to arrive this afternoon too.
Man: The desks are on schedule, though the delivery window is one to five. Let's make sure someone is here then.
Woman: Okay. And the lamps? I heard they were canceled.
Man: Yes, the supplier dropped them from the order. We'll buy them locally instead.
translation:
男性:やあ、リナ。オフィス家具の納品がまた遅れているんだ。まだ届いていないのはどれ?
女性:椅子は今朝届く予定だったけど、トラックが高速道路で止まっているの。
男性:昼食後に届くと言っていたから、今日の予定には間に合うよ。
女性:机は?今日の午後に届く予定だったわよね。
男性:机は予定どおりだよ。届く時間帯は1時から5時だけど、その時間に誰かが会社にいるようにしてね。
女性:わかったわ。それからランプは?キャンセルされたと聞いたけど。
男性:そうなんだ。納入業者が注文から外したんだ。代わりに地元で買うことにしよう。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which furniture arrives in the afternoon and is on time?
choices: The chairs, which arrive in the morning window.
The lamps, which the supplier cancelled.
The desks, which are running as planned.
The item due from eight to twelve.
questions.explanation: 図表で午後1〜5時の時間帯で予定どおりなのは机である。椅子は遅れ、ランプはキャンセルされている。

questions.question: Why will the chairs arrive later than planned?
choices: The supplier ran out of chairs.
The office was closed this morning.
The building entrance is blocked for repairs.
The delivery vehicle is held up on the motorway.
questions.explanation: トラックが高速道路で止まっているため、椅子は今朝の予定から遅れている。

questions.question: What will the man do about the lamps?
choices: Buy them from a local store.
Ask the supplier for a refund.
Wait until next month for delivery.
Ask staff to bring lamps from home.
questions.explanation: ランプは納入業者の注文から外れたので、男性は代わりに地元で買うと言っている。

title: Overtime approval policy
script:
Man: The new overtime policy starts next month. Did you read the draft?
Woman: I did. Employees will need approval before working more than ten hours a day.
Man 2: That's going to slow down the packaging team. They often stay late to meet the shipping deadlines.
Man: The policy exempts urgent shipments, though. Managers can approve extra hours without the usual form.
Woman: That's the problem. Managers will decide what counts as urgent, and that might be used unevenly.
Man 2: We should ask HR to define urgent in writing. Otherwise the team will just wait for approval.
Man: I'll raise it at Thursday's meeting. Let's bring a draft definition with us.
translation:
男性:新しい残業ルールは来月から始まるね。案は読んだ?
女性:読んだわ。1日10時間を超えて働くには、事前の承認が必要になるのね。
男性2:それだと梱包チームが遅れそうです。出荷期限に間に合わせるために、よく残業していますから。
男性:でも、緊急の出荷は例外になっているよ。マネージャーは通常の書式なしで残業を承認できる。
女性:そこが問題なのよ。何が緊急かはマネージャーが決めることになって、不公平に使われるかもしれないわ。
男性2:人事に、緊急の定義を文書で決めてもらうべきです。さもないと、チームは承認を待つだけになってしまう。
男性:木曜の会議で取り上げるよ。定義の案を持っていこう。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "That's the problem."?
choices: The packaging team should work longer hours.
The policy has already been approved by HR.
The exemption could be applied inconsistently from one manager to another.
Managers should not be allowed to approve overtime.
questions.explanation: 緊急かどうかの判断がマネージャーに任されると、人によって扱いが変わるおそれがあるという意味である。

questions.question: What would slow down the packaging team?
choices: A shortage of packing materials.
Having to get approval before working long hours.
Late deliveries from the supplier.
Changes to the shipping schedule.
questions.explanation: 1日10時間を超える前に承認が必要になると、梱包チームの作業が遅れるという指摘である。

questions.question: What will the man do next?
choices: Raise the issue at Thursday's meeting.
Approve the policy without changes.
Take the packaging team to HR.
Cancel the overtime policy entirely.
questions.explanation: 男性は木曜の会議で取り上げ、定義の案を持っていくと言っている。

title: Remote work pilot results
script:
Woman: The remote work pilot ended last month, and the survey results are in.
Man: Productivity went up for the developers, but customer support says response times got worse.
Woman: That's what worries me. Support staff rely on being in the same room to pass difficult calls to each other.
Man: But the support team had the highest satisfaction in the survey. Most of them said they like the flexibility.
Woman: Flexibility matters, but some of them said they'd prefer two days a week in the office.
Man: So maybe the answer is hybrid, with supervisors deciding the in-office days for each team.
Woman: That could work, but it would mean the rule is different everywhere, and HR wants one policy.
Man: Then let's keep the pilot running for the support team with two office days, and check again in March.
translation:
女性:リモートワークの試験運用が先月終わって、アンケートの結果が出たわ。
男性:開発チームは生産性が上がったけど、サポートチームは対応時間が悪くなったと言っているよ。
女性:そこが心配なのよ。サポートの人は、難しい問い合わせを同じ部屋で互いに回すことに頼っているから。
男性:でも、アンケートではサポートチームの満足度が一番高かったよ。ほとんどが柔軟な働き方を気に入っているって。
女性:柔軟さは大事だけど、週2日は出社したいという人もいたわ。
男性:だったら、チームごとに管理職が出社日を決めるハイブリッド型がいいのかもしれない。
女性:それもありだけど、ルールがどこでも違うことになるわ。人事は一本化したいと言っているし。
男性:じゃあ、サポートチームだけ週2日出社で試験運用を続けて、3月にもう一度確認しよう。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "That's what worries me."?
choices: She thinks the developers should return to the office.
She is confident the survey results are accurate.
She wants the pilot to end in March.
She fears that the support team will lose the ability to help each other quickly.
questions.explanation: サポートの人は同じ部屋で難しい問い合わせを回しているので、その助け合いが失われることを心配している。

questions.question: Why does the man want to keep the pilot for the support team?
choices: The team reported the highest satisfaction in the survey.
The developers have asked to stay remote.
Customers prefer phone support from home.
Office rent will increase next year.
questions.explanation: アンケートでサポートチームの満足度が一番高かったことを、男性は理由に挙げている。

questions.question: What will the group most likely decide?
choices: Full remote work for all teams.
Two office days a week for the support team only.
Ending the pilot for every team.
Moving the support staff to the developers' floor.
questions.explanation: 週2日の出社でサポートチームだけ試験運用を続け、3月に確認する案に話が進んでいる。

title: Offsite agenda and sales workshop
script:
Man: The agenda for the offsite is ready, but the CEO wants to cut the workshops to make room for a keynote.
Woman: Which workshops? The sales workshop is the one most people asked for in the survey.
Man: The sales workshop was first on the list, but the facilitator is unavailable on that date.
Woman: We could move it to the afternoon session on the second day, if the facilitator agrees.
Man: That's where the budget session is. Finance won't move it, because the CFO only attends mornings.
Woman: Then how about a shorter version? Thirty minutes before lunch.
Man: The facilitator said thirty minutes isn't enough to cover the material. She would need at least ninety.
Woman: So the sales workshop is out, unless the keynote moves to the first session on day one.
Man: The CEO agreed to move the keynote to the first session this morning, so the sales workshop gets the Tuesday morning slot.
translation:
男性:社員旅行の議題はできたけど、CEOが基調講演の時間を増やすために、ワークショップを減らしたがっているんだ。
女性:どのワークショップ?営業のワークショップは、アンケートで一番希望が多かったものよ。
男性:営業のワークショップは最初の候補だったけど、進行役がその日は空いていないんだ。
女性:それなら、2日目の午後のセッションに移せないかしら。進行役が了承すれば。
男性:そこは予算のセッションなんだ。財務部は動かさないと言っている。CFOは午前しか出席しないからね。
女性:じゃあ、短縮版はどう?昼食前の30分にするの。
男性:進行役が言うには、30分では内容を扱えないそうだ。最低90分はいるって。
女性:それなら、営業のワークショップは無理ね。基調講演が1日目の最初のセッションに移らない限り。
男性:CEOは今朝、基調講演を1日目の最初のセッションに移すことに同意したよ。だから営業のワークショップは火曜の午前の枠に入る。

questions.question: Where will the sales workshop be held?
choices: In the afternoon budget session on the second day.
In a thirty-minute slot before lunch.
In the first session of day one, next to the keynote.
In the Tuesday morning slot the keynote gave up.
questions.explanation: 基調講演が1日目の最初のセッションに移ったため、もとの火曜午前の枠が営業のワークショップに回る。

questions.question: Why can't the sales workshop take the afternoon slot?
choices: The facilitator is unavailable in the afternoon.
That slot is already taken by the budget session.
The workshop would run past closing time.
The CEO wants the afternoon for the keynote.
questions.explanation: 2日目の午後は予算のセッションが入っており、財務部は動かさないと言っている。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "So the sales workshop is out"?
choices: The workshop has been canceled permanently.
The facilitator has agreed to a shorter session.
The CEO has refused to move the keynote.
The sales workshop cannot fit into the schedule as things stand.
questions.explanation: 現状の予定では、営業のワークショップは入る余地がないという意味である。基調講演が動けば入る可能性がある。
